objective: Harden the existing OKX BTC-USDT microstructure forward bundle into a strict, deterministic, offline-verifiable tooling contract, while keeping every bundle non-canonical until a separately reviewed continuous producer, one-way transport, and server intake contract exists.

inputs.locator: The validated read-only audit concluded that the portable bundle schema is permissive, the seal lacks an independent validator, and the current bounded collector is smoke tooling only. Implement the smallest offline contract-hardening slice; source-to-canonical binding and continuous operation remain MISSING_PROOF and out of scope.

stop_conditions: Modify at most the bundle schema, one offline validator module, research_pipeline/cli.py, one focused test module, and the microstructure source document; preserve every other existing worktree change.
Do not edit the Java collector, the V6 cloud contract, deployment files, schedules, server state, canonical research state, or .research-state.
Do not run the collector, Maven, Java, an adapter, a strategy runner, or any network request; use deterministic non-network fixtures only.

The validator must independently recompute the declared seal and fail closed on unknown fields, malformed types, non-contiguous minutes, stream gaps, integrity anomalies, inconsistent eligibility, or an altered payload.

Do not claim that strict local validation makes a bundle canonical; report source identity, continuous UTC-day operation, one-way transport, server intake, predecessor binding, and prospective performance value as MISSING_PROOF.
Stop without widening scope if implementation would require a second timer, local canonical writer, historical backfill, paid API, OOS, Trading access, or strategy activation.
